- c98fbe0 feat(settings): choose the Hubspace Collab opens on startup (#401)

Users with several Hubspaces always landed in the last one they used.

**Settings → General** now has a **Open on startup** option. Choose **Last used** (the old behavior) or pick a specific Hubspace.
